landing.text: Features Pricing Log in Upload my menu → Upload menu Log in The ordering system built for food trucks. Upload your menu, no signup needed. See a working demo in under 60 seconds. Less time booking. More time cooking. Upload my menu → No signup, no card. See it working in under 60 seconds. First month 100% free, everything unlocked No card needed Cancel anytime, no contract What it does Built for food trucks, not restaurants. Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You’re somewhere new every week, at different times, on patchy or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was built for that. Customers choose collection times Customers order ahead and pick a collection time. Less queues, and food ready when they arrive. Set your kitchen capacity Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can’t pick it. Works on any device Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card machine you already take payment on. Automate your Facebook & Instagram posts Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We’ll fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day. WhatsApp auto-replies “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you’re driving to the pitch or at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon. No signal? Keep serving. If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Carry on taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app. Getting going Get set up and start taking orders in about 15 minutes. Three things to sort — and two of them just need a photo. Build your menu Photograph your board or paste it in. Items, prices and extras all come across on their own. You just check they’re right. Add your schedule Got it on your website? We’ll read it from there and keep it up to date. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what it finds. Share your link Post it on Facebook, stick the QR on the van. Orders land on your screen, in the order you need to cook them. “ HatchGrab has made ordering so much easier. Everything's organised, we can track stock and know exactly how many pizzas we have left to sell — and the time slots are fantastic for busy villages. Nadia & Bogdan Owners, Pizzeria Gusto Mobile Pizzeria of the Year Regional winner Pricing Start free. Upgrade when you need to. Pro is £29 a month with £1,500 of online orders included. Max is £49 with £2,000 . Anything above that is 0.99% . Standard card processing fees apply to all online orders (currently 1.5% + 20p on standard UK cards ), including those within your allowance. Walk-ups carry no HatchGrab platform fee on any plan. Your card terminal's own fees still apply. Your first month is completely free — every feature unlocked. With Pay at Hatch, customers order ahead and pay when they collect, so you can take online orders without connecting a card processor at all. Prefer to take payment up front? Add online card payments any time. Adding online payments doesn’t start your subscription . You’re only charged when you actively select a paid plan. We’ll never charge you without your clear permission. No card to start, cancel anytime.
